scope: R2.3 Gaussian-noise filter validation; no quantisation or bit-error channel
repeat_choice: Fixed budget of 50 independent two-second records per condition (400 records total); report achieved uncertainty, without claiming a guaranteed precision or adapting the count to validation outcomes

conditions.role: high-SNR diagnostic above predicted 34.79 dB crossover

primary_metric: Full-record mean squared error against the unchanged reference on the reconstructed 48000 Hz grid
pairing: The same contaminated array feeds filter and no-filter branches; both use the unchanged R1.2 periodic reconstruction
alignment: Fixed d=192 centred crop, zero extension; no fitted gain, fitted shift, endpoint removal, or waveform normalisation
interval_method: Mean +/- t.ppf(0.975,49)*sample_std(ddof=1)/sqrt(50); pointwise approximate Monte Carlo mean intervals, not simultaneous intervals or sample-wise error bars
reference_use: Original samples are used to generate artificial degradation and evaluate error only; the recovery functions receive contaminated samples and frozen coefficients
raw_storage: Save two predetermined full-resolution example pairs as CSV; all other records replay from versioned seed paths, initial states, call shapes and raw-array SHA256 hashes
crossover: Compare the existing sample-domain prediction with measured high-SNR diagnostics; do not reselect the filter or estimate a universal threshold from two points
